title: PJM Announces Governmental and Member Services Leadership Changes

meta.summary: PJM Interconnection and CEO David Mills today announced leadership changes in Governmental and Member Services under Asim Z. Haque, Executive Vice President, Governmental and Member Services. Jason Stanek, previously Executive Director, Governmental Services, has been named vice president, Federal Policy, effective Dec. 9, 2026. Stanek will assume responsibility for all of PJM’s engagement and relationships […]
